info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Machine learning associations API
List Query Pipeline ML Model Associations

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target Coveo Cloud organization.

Specifying a value for this parameter is only necessary when you are authenticating the API call with an OAuth2 token.

params.name: pipelineId
params.description: The unique identifier of the target query pipeline.

params.name: page
params.description: The 0-based number of the page of results to get.

params.name: perPage
params.description: The number of results to include per page.

params.name: filter
params.description:
Filter associations by model display name or description (case-insensitive substring match).

For example, `filter=product` will match associations where the model display name or description contains "product".

By default, all associations are returned when no filter is specified.

items.docs:
Gets a page of Coveo Machine Learning model associations for a specific query pipeline.

<summary>Privilege(s) required</summary>

```json
{"level":"NORMAL","owner":"SEARCH_API","targetDomain":"QUERY_PIPELINE","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"}
```
</details>
